request.spec:
A hold now has a from-date (default the sheet's today) and an optional to-date, and a person may
have several holds over time. Only a person's OPEN claims dated within a hold are left out of the
live totals; their other open claims count, and a claim bound by a statement stays in the totals
whatever its date. Show hold yes/no as whether the person has any hold. Holding writes
PERSON_HELD name=<name> from=<date>; releasing is no longer a separate action (a hold ends on
its to-date).

A hold now has a from-date (default the sheet's today) and an optional to-date, and a person may

whatever its date. Show hold yes/no as whether the person has any hold. Holding writes

Your work is verified by an automated Playwright UI test already installed under e2e/specs/.
Read that spec: it declares the exact data-testid anchors, values, test data and any audit

AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, DESIGN.md, e2e/support/ or the test spec.

agent.result_text:
Holds now have dates, and a person can have several. `bin/e2e` builds the app and runs the acceptance spec; all 4 tests pass.

**What changed**
- **Stored data:** a new migration, `V28__person_hold.sql`, adds a `person_hold` table holding each hold's from-date and optional to-date. It removes the old `person.held` yes/no column. Anyone already on hold is moved over as one hold from the earliest possible date with no end, so their totals don't change.
- **Server:** an existing claim is left out of the live totals only when all of these are true:
  - it is OPEN;
  - a statement doesn't bind it;
  - one of the person's holds covers its date. Both ends of a hold count as inside it, and a hold with no to-date never ends.

  This one rule is used everywhere totals are worked out: the rollups, statements and closing a period.
- **Holding someone** (`POST …/hold`) adds a hold instead of switching it on and off. A blank from-date takes the sheet's today. It writes `PERSON_HELD … name=<name> from=<date>`, and writes `ROLLUP`/`TOTALS` lines only when the figures actually change. Releasing and `PERSON_RELEASED` are gone.
- **Screen:** each person's row lists their holds (`person-hold-line`) and has from and to date inputs (`person-hold-from`, `person-hold-to`) next to the existing **Hold** button (`person-hold-toggle`). `person-hold` shows yes/no for whether the person has any hold. The live totals, the people list and period totals all use the dated rule.

**Choices you may want to check**
- **PENDING claims:** a PENDING claim dated within a hold is also left out. The app already treats PENDING as open, and a statement never binds a PENDING claim. If "OPEN" was meant strictly, this is a one-line change.
- **Refused holds:** a hold is refused, showing `person-error`, if a date isn't a valid date or the to-date is before the from-date. The request doesn't say this; I added it.

The test helpers in `e2e/support/ui.ts` include a `bulkHold` function, but nothing uses it in this spec and the app has no bulk-hold feature, so I didn't build one.
